1.1: This here's the vision Obadiah got from the Lord. The Lord sayin' somethin' real clear 'bout Edom: We done heard from the Lord, and He done sent a message to the nations sayin, "Get up! Let's roll out! Time to run up on Edom."
1.2: "I'ma bring you down real low, Edom. Everybody gon' be lookin' down on you."
1.3: "You real full of yourself, huh? Livin' all tucked up in them mountains, thinkin' can't nobody touch you. Up there like, 'Who gon' bring me down?'"
1.4: "Even if you flew up high like an eagle, Built your spot up in the stars, I'ma still bring you down," say the Lord.
1.5: "If robbers pulled up on you at night, They'd only take what they needed. If folks came through to pick your grapes, They'd still leave a lil' somethin' behind. But you? You gon' get cleaned out."
1.6: "Esau's secrets gon' get exposed. All them stashed-up treasures? Gone."
1.7: "Your so-called allies? They gon' push you right up to the border and leave you hangin'. Folks you broke bread with? They setting traps behind your back—and you don't even see it."
1.8: "When I move, I'ma wipe out Edom's so-called 'wise men.' Ain't gon' be no more knowledge left up in them hills of Esau."
1.9: "Even your strongest folks, Teman, Gon' be shook. And everybody in them mountains? Wiped out. Slaughtered."
1.10: "'Cause you did your brother Jacob dirty. You gon' wear that shame like a coat. And I'ma cut you off—for good."
1.11: "Back when enemies rolled up on Jerusalem, You ain't help. You stood on the sidelines, Watchin' strangers tear through the city like it wasn't your people. You was actin' just like them."
1.12: "You had no business grinnin' while Judah was fallin'. You was talkin' slick when they was hurtin'. That ain't it."
1.13: "You stepped into the city when My people was down bad. You looked through they pain like it was a show. Then you turned around and started takin' they stuff."
1.14: "You even blocked the roads, Stopped folks tryin' to escape. Turned over the ones who got away. All that while they was sufferin'? Wild."
1.15: "The day of the Lord comin' for every nation. What you did? Gon' come right back to you. Whatever mess you threw out? It's boomerangin' to your own head."
1.16: "Y'all drank on My holy mountain like it was sweet. Now all the nations gon' drink, too. Drink and choke on it—like they never even existed."
1.17: "But up on Mount Zion? That's where the freedom at. That's where the holy ones gon' live. Jacob's house gon' reclaim what's theirs."
1.18: "Jacob gon' be fire. Joseph? A flame. Esau's house? Just dry stubble. That fire gon' burn through 'em, and won't nobody from Esau's crew make it out. That's the Lord talkin'."
1.19: "Folks from the South gon' take over Esau's mountains. The valleys gon' be runnin' Philistia. Ephraim and Samaria? Reclaimed. Benjamin's folks takin' back Gilead."
1.20: "The exiles from Israel gon' get back Canaan, All the way to Zarephath. The ones from Jerusalem that's in Sepharad? They comin' back to the cities down south."
1.21: "And then, some real leaders—saviors—gon' rise up in Zion. They gon' judge Edom's mountain. And the kingdom? Oh yeah, it gon' belong to the Lord."
